description: A Java class 'LogView' that extends TextView and implements the LogNode interface, designed to display log data in a UI component within an Android application.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, supporting chaining with other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays log data with priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable; also forwards the log to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to concatenate strings with delimiters if they are not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
